summary: Iteration 3 (customer marketplace: quoting → instant offers OR bidding → mock payment/deposit) full E2E test. Backend pytest: 25/25 passed (~7s). Coverage: public van sizes, pricing-bounds, quote, address suggest gate; auth register+login+role gating (customer blocked from /admin & /driver); driver signup carries home_postcode + pricing; pending driver blocked from /driver/available; booking created with status='quoting', driver_id=null, payment.status='unpaid'; GET /bookings/{id}/instant-offers returns tagged offers (cheapest+closest); POST /bookings/{id}/select-driver with payment_type='deposit' → booking assigned, payment.status='paid', amount=15%*price, balance_due=price-amount, transaction_id=MOCK-*; 'full' → amount=price, balance_due=0; invalid payment_type → 400; double-assign → 400; /track reveals driver.phone after payment; bidding: broadcast sets mode='bidding' + radius=30; driver sees job in /driver/available (SE1 pickup within radius); driver POST /driver/jobs/{id}/bid → 'waiting'; duplicate bid → 400; customer sees bid in GET /bookings/{id}/bids; select-driver in bidding mode uses bid price (deposit = 15% of bid); chat masks phone (07123 456 789) and email (foo@bar.com) as '[contact hidden]'; chat rejected if no driver assigned (400); driver /driver/pricing POST clamps rates to per-band bounds (small 35–45, stairs 5–15, helper 15–25); notifications endpoints work; uploads regression still green. Frontend Playwright (mobile 430×900) exercised: /register (register-*) → landed on /jobs with BottomNav visible; created booking via API; created approved driver via burner admin context → /jobs shows: 'Choosing driver' badge, pay-deposit/pay-full toggle, Refund guarantee box, mode-instant / mode-bidding, 2 offer-<id> cards with Cheapest+Closest tags, Accept text switches £27.00 (deposit) ↔ £180.00 (full), profile-<id> opens profile-modal; Accept — deposit navigated to /track/MWV71F2078B; driver phone 07111222333 visible on Track; Message button opens ChatModal, sending 'Call me on 07123456789 or email me at foo@bar.com' returns '[contact hidden]' (raw phone/email are NOT leaked); second booking Bidding mode triggered toast 'Sent to 8 drivers within 30 miles' + rebroadcast button + no-bids empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: MyJobs.jsx OfferList renders a disabled 'Message' button that calls a stub `onChatUnavailable()` — the `onChat` prop is passed in but never used before accept. Consider hiding the button entirely (or wiring it to a tooltip) instead of leaving a dead handler.

select-driver has no server-side guard that the chosen driver was actually one of the returned instant-offers (or a bidder). A malicious customer could pass any approved driver_id. Consider requiring: for instant → driver still within radius/available; for bidding → an existing bid row from that driver.

admin_stats revenue includes 'assigned' bookings that were only 15% deposited — the deposit amount vs the full price is not distinguished. Consider reporting captured revenue (sum of payment.amount) vs booked value separately.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan.
CORS: allow_credentials=True together with allow_origins='*' fallback is browser-inert; set an explicit origins list in env for prod.
No brute-force lockout on /auth/login or /auth/driver-register (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails).

instant-offers 'exact_radius=false' branch always returns nearest 3 even when they're 30+ mi away, which produces awkward 'Nearest drivers (just outside 5 miles)' copy at 25 mi. Either widen radius or hide when distance > BIDDING_RADIUS_MI.

MyJobs.jsx: `bookings.find(status==='quoting')` returns only ONE active job — users with multiple pending quotes will only see the first one. Consider listing all quoting bookings and letting users switch.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (25 tests, ~7s under pytest-xdist). Key notes: (1) `driver_distance_mi` is a deterministic hash of (base_postcode, pickup); to guarantee a driver is inside the bidding radius (30 mi) use pickup 'SE1 1AA London' with driver home_postcode 'SW1A 1AA' (=> 3.2 mi). Pickup 'SW1A 1AA London' with same home_postcode = 31 mi and is OUT of range. (2) BottomNav testids are `tab-book`, `tab-my-jobs`, `tab-messages`, `tab-account` (NOT nav-*). (3) Payment is fully mocked — select-driver returns a MOCK-<hex> transaction_id and sets payment.status='paid'; no Stripe. (4) Chat opens only after driver_id is set on booking (returns 400 otherwise). (5) To seed an approved driver for UI tests, POST /api/admin/drivers as admin (creates driver directly with status='approved'). (6) Currently no server-side validation that the chosen driver was in the offer list — see critical_code_review_comments.
